assets.purpose: Show a mesenchymal mass arising from the GI wall and growing exophytically; central low-attenuation area is illustrative, not a diagnostic scan.
assets.source: Created for RadYar; no external image used.
User-provided Abdomen.pdf, physical PDF page 68 (printed page 67), three panels retained from original source slide.
assets.source_identifier_embedded: The PDF text layer contains rID:73152 in very small embedded text; it is not a clearly visible footer at normal viewing size. The source website, case author/contributor, study accession and frame/phase labels are not identified by the supplied PDF.
assets.selection_rationale: Directly shows the source-described lobulated gastric-origin mass with low-attenuation areas in axial and coronal views.
assets.reuse: User authorized supplied PDF images for this project. Independent rights/licence verification has not been performed.
assets.limitations: Individual CT phases are not assigned because the slide does not label them. No added arrows or diagnostic overlays.
